en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: If it is said: First prove to us the veracity of these narrations,
for they are singularly narrated traditions and do not prove a topic for sure. This is a subject that requires certainty.
Secondly, prove to us that these narrations intend the Imams you believe in.
The traditions you narrated from your opponents, and the majority of them you narrated through your own sources, if we set aside their disputability, they do not mention the Imamate of your Imams,
How do you say that your Imams are the ones intended by these traditions?
